notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 53309e94 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 02ab31d5 - Merge branch wireshark:master into master
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20669/diffs?diff_id=1437434782&start_sha=0228df5bfe6e8510696863a10be56cc6c27d1e78)

added 2 commits
  • 3dc173ed - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 32f0ad57 - Merge branch wireshark:master into master
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20669/diffs?diff_id=1437442239&start_sha=02ab31d59aace12e5a52147fb5ed9b484c108823)

The content of the branch looks okay to me. However three things to fix in your Merge Request:
1. You'll have to make a branch on which you put your changes. We can't merge from your master branch to this master branch.
2. When updating your branch, use rebase instead of merge commits.
3. We strongly prefer a single commit per MR.
Thanks for pointers. I will close this MR and prepare new one with your fix recommendations.
